summary: Chicago police used a predictive model to score hundreds of thousands of residents on their risk of involvement in violence, and visited some people who had no recent crimes. Critics said the data was biased and that Black residents bore the consequences.
technical_summary: The Strategic Subject List and related models derived risk scores from police-recorded arrest and location data, which over-represent heavily policed groups and neighborhoods. Biased training data produced skewed predictions that drove police visits and monitoring, with limited transparency about how scores were built.

summary: Ahead of Germany's 2025 federal election, Russian-linked campaigns spread false claims about German politicians using AI-altered videos, fake news sites and bot networks. Researchers and German intelligence said the aim was to erode trust and boost the far right.
technical_summary: Operations such as Storm-1516, Doppelganger and Matryoshka combined AI-generated deepfake videos, AI-built imitation news sites and automated social accounts to seed and amplify fabricated scandals at scale. Platform moderation was insufficient to stop coordinated cross-platform spread.

summary: Researchers linked to the University of Zurich secretly ran AI-powered bots on a Reddit debate forum for months, some posing as invented personas such as a rape survivor, to test persuasion. Moderators and Reddit called it unauthorized and unethical.

The research deviated from ethical norms for human-subjects studies and manipulated unwitting participants.
